_comment: Reviewed label-only renames of proxy storage rows. The slot, offset and type are pinned: only the name changes, so the proxy layout is untouched. check-core-storage-layout.sh applies these to a baseline snapshot before it checks that the live layout extends it. Do not add entries for a moved or retyped variable. libraryRenames: reviewed source-path renames of a linked library (the fully qualified name only). They are applied to the baseline's library list; a library missing from this list still fails.

renames.reason: SYS-1: a vaults-system contract names no gateway. The slot is retired (never written, never read) and keeps its position. The public getter gateway() is dropped from the ABI.

libraryRenames.reason: The fund sources moved from contracts/test/prototype/src into contracts/ with the same layout. Only the library's source path changed; its runtime code is identical apart from the CBOR metadata (owner decision 2026-11-19).
